title: FRACMATH: Vectorized continuum damage simulation with hybrid GPU computing, crack-band regularization and an Abaqus UMAT
description: FRACMATH provides vectorized MATLAB scalar continuum damage simulation, direction-dependent Oliver crack-band regularization, a hybrid GPU backend with CPU sparse assembly and factorization, and an Abaqus plane-stress UMAT. Current SoftwareX companions include ten representative MATLAB-UMAT material examples, completed exact-mesh fixed-increment medium/fine bending comparisons, a three-mesh element-area versus Oliver-width study, and CPU modified-von-Mises versus maximum-positive-principal-strain comparison. Three completed 3D pure-tension meshes provide a numerical mesh-consistency check; mixed-mode and torsion fields are qualitative demonstrations. Current figures do not report experimental validation. Original fixed-increment convergence failures are preserved as diagnostics. Separate message-file solver timers, UMAT timers and native assembly profiles have explicitly limited scopes; they do not form a complete Abaqus wall-time partition. Earlier hardware observations remain optional archives. This metadata retains the v1.1.1 numerical-core archive identity; current companions must also be cited by their exact repository commit.
